name: Superior and inferior petrosal sinuses
summary: Two channels draining the cavernous sinus backward: the superior petrosal sinus runs along the petrous ridge in the attached margin of the tentorium to the transverse sinus, and the inferior petrosal sinus runs in the groove between the petrous bone and the clivus to the jugular bulb. The superior sinus crosses the trigeminal root at Meckel's cave and the inferior sinus passes beside the abducens nerve in Dorello's canal and the glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves at the jugular foramen. The inferior petrosal sinus is catheterized to sample pituitary ACTH in Cushing disease.

anatomy.location: Superior petrosal sinus along the superior border of the petrous temporal bone from the cavernous sinus to the transverse sinus; inferior petrosal sinus along the petro-occipital fissure from the cavernous sinus to the jugular foramen.

function: Drainage of the cavernous sinus and of the cerebellum, brainstem and inner ear (via the labyrinthine and petrosal veins) into the lateral sinuses and jugular bulb.

arteries: (venous structure) drains territories of the cerebral arteries

bestView.label: superior petrosal sinus along the petrous ridge
inferior petrosal sinus beside the clivus

imaging.normalAppearance: Thin channels seen on contrast-enhanced venography along the petrous ridge and the clivus; the inferior petrosal sinus is the route for petrosal sampling, and the petrosal veins are involved in dural fistulas of the tentorium.

pathology.finding: Abnormal arterialized flow in the petrosal veins and superior petrosal sinus with cortical venous reflux; risk of hemorrhage.
Inflammation of the petrous apex with abducens palsy and facial pain from involvement of Dorello's canal and Meckel's cave.

lesionEffects.deficit: Abducens palsy with retro-orbital pain and otitis (Gradenigo)
lesionEffects.mechanism: Inflammation at the petrous apex where the nerve and inferior petrosal sinus run
Superior petrosal sinus at Meckel's cave
Dural fistula draining through the petrosal veins

examination: Lateral rectus function and facial sensation
Auscultate the mastoid for a bruit
pearls: Sixth nerve palsy plus facial pain plus ear discharge is the petrous apex
The inferior petrosal sinus is where endocrinologists go to prove that ACTH is coming from the pituitary
